purpose: Map every repository problem to one exact subject, explicit dependencies, bounded candidate moves, one admissible next transition, and a mandatory readback without collapsing evidence, authority, or external effects.
roots: Issue #854 reflexive error correction and prevention
selection_rules: Reject a move that transfers evidence from a different subject.
Reject a move that weakens a hard non-equivalence or widens authority.
Reject a move whose required dependency is unresolved.
If the subject binding is stale, emit REOBSERVE before any mutation.
If the best otherwise-admissible move requires unavailable external authority, emit REQUEST_AUTHORITY.
Execute at most one mutating move per cycle.
Independent read-only observations may execute in parallel and must merge deterministically.
Every executed move requires an explicit expected readback and a successor receipt.
A repair is incomplete until at least one executable prevention mechanism is bound where technically possible.
completion_rule: A local problem cycle may terminate when the declared closure predicate is satisfied on the exact current subject. New evidence creates a successor cycle; local closure never implies global finality.
external_effect_rule: Repository-native resolution may prepare or route an external effect, but publication, deployment, merge, physical action, approval, PASS, FINAL_PASS, or EFFECT_ACK_DONE require their own authoritative effect and readback evidence.
